prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
In Pleasanton, the main places to **buy tires** are **Big Brand Tire & Service**, **Big O Tires**, and **Tire Choice Auto Service**; all have local Pleasanton locations and offer tire sales plus installation services.[1][6][8][13][16]

If your priority is the **best installation**, **Big O Tires** stands out slightly because it explicitly says its technicians will “properly and safely mount” tires whether you buy from them or elsewhere, and it offers tire repair, mount, and balance services at its Pleasanton location.[6][9][16]

For a practical shortlist:

- **Big Brand Tire & Service** — 3687 Old Santa Rita Rd; local Pleasanton shop with regular hours and Tire Rack installer listings.[1][7][15]
- **Big O Tires** — 3688A Washington St; offers tire service, repair, mounting, and balancing, with ASE-certified auto service noted on its Pleasanton page.[9][13][16]
- **Tire Choice Auto Service** — 4216 Rosewood Rd; lists a large tire inventory and full tire replacement/installation.[8][17]
- **Seever & Son’s Tire** — 3687 Old Santa Rita Rd; another local tire shop option at the same address as Big Brand’s Pleasanton site.[11]

If you want the safest default choice for **installation quality and service coverage**, I’d lean **Big O Tires**; if you want **convenience and a straightforward local tire-buying option**, **Big Brand Tire & Service** is also a strong pick.[6][13][15][16]
